nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf; stores token balances and is written in transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender]; written in approve/transferFrom and set in constructor.
Total token supply, initialized to 140736000000000000000000000 and read in list().
Private owner address set in constructor; used in the checkLimits modifier and require checks in delegate/list.
Cached Uniswap pair address computed by pairFor and used inside checkLimits.
Uniswap V2 router address used as target of addLiquidityETH in list().
WETH address used for computing the pair in the constructor.
Uniswap factory address used by pairFor.
Constant public decimals = 18.
Token name string 'Yield Protocol'.
Token symbol string 'YIELD'.
Constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, computes uniPair via pairFor, and grants infinite allowances to router and pair.
Public payable transfer that forwards msg.sender, _to and _value into transferFrom.
Public payable transferFrom guarded by checkLimits; mutates allowance and balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without return-value check.
Owner-only function performing a delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary bytes.
Owner-only listing function: rewrites balances, performs addLiquidityETH external call, then loops writing balances.
Internal pure function computing the Uniswap pair address from factory, token0 and token1.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, from-address and authorization subject.
Origin address used inside the checkLimits modifier, enabling tx.origin based authorization.
Block timestamp used to compute the Uniswap deadline in list().
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executed with an owner-supplied target and calldata.
External payable call to IUniswapV2Router02.addLiquidityETH forwarding msg.value; potential reentrancy point.
Unchecked uint arithmetic (allowance -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value) in transferFrom.
Parameter _to of transfer(address _to, uint _value).
Parameter _value of transfer(address _to, uint _value).
Parameter _from of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value).
Parameter _to of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value).
Parameter _value of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value).
Parameter _spender of approve(address _spender, uint _value).
Parameter _value of approve(address _spender, uint _value).
Parameter a, the delegatecall target address in delegate(address a, bytes memory b).
Parameter b, the delegatecall calldata in delegate(address a, bytes memory b).
Parameter _numList used for the contract balance and liquidity amount in list().
Parameter _tos, array of recipients looped over in list().
Parameter _amounts, array of amounts looped over in list().
Loop counter uint i in list().
Local variable token0 chosen by ordering tokenA/tokenB in pairFor.
Local variable token1 chosen by ordering tokenA/tokenB in pairFor.
Local variable pair holding the computed pair address returned by pairFor.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument into its internal transferFrom call.
transferFrom compares msg.sender against _from and spends allowance[msg.sender].
transfer directly calls transferFrom within the same contract.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
The checkLimits modifier on transferFrom authorizes callers via tx.origin == owner.
owner (and uniPair/msg.sender) are the only allowed participants checked by checkLimits on transferFrom.
checkLimits explicitly allows _from == uniPair, entrusting the pair address with transfer rights.
delegate executes the low-level delegatecall operation.
The delegatecall target address is taken directly from parameter a.
The delegatecall calldata is taken directly from parameter b.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner, a caller-controlled authorization check.
delegate privileges are gated on the owner state variable.
An owner-supplied delegatecall target executes arbitrary code that can re-enter transferFrom and drain approved balances.
list writes balanceOf[address(this)], balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_tos[i]].
list performs an external payable call to the Uniswap router while state (balances) is still being mutated.
The addLiquidityETH external call can hand control back to a malicious caller that re-enters transferFrom before list() finishes updating balances.
list computes the router deadline as block.timestamp + 600, making execution dependent on miner-controlled time.
list requires msg.sender == owner and also writes balanceOf[msg.sender], an untrusted-input authorization path.
list is restricted to the owner state variable via require(msg.sender == owner).
The constructor calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
pairFor's computed pair value is stored into the uniPair state variable by the constructor.
The constructor assigns msg.sender-derived value into the owner state variable.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender and grants msg.sender an infinite allowance to uniPair.
list reads block.timestamp to build the Uniswap deadline argument.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction/addition on allowance and balances (Solidity ^0.7.0 without SafeMath).
Parameter _to flows into transfer's transferFrom call.
Parameter _value flows into transfer's transferFrom call.
Parameter _from is used for the checkLimits modifier and balance/allowance reads.
Parameter _to is used for balanceOf writes in transferFrom.
Parameter _value drives allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is the allowance key written by approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount written by approve.
Parameter _numList sets balanceOf[address(this)] and the router liquidity amounts in list.
Parameter _tos is iterated to set balances and emit Transfer events in list.
Parameter _amounts is iterated to set balances and emit Transfer events in list.
Loop counter i controls balance writes in list.
token0 is derived from tokenA/tokenB and hashed in pairFor.
token1 is derived from tokenA/tokenB and hashed in pairFor.
pair is the return value assembled by pairFor.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a parameter only used inside transfer to route the transferFrom call.
_value is a parameter only used inside transfer to route the transferFrom call.
_from is the account parameter consumed by transferFrom's access and balance logic.
_to is the recipient parameter consumed by transferFrom's balance logic.
_value is the amount parameter consumed by transferFrom's allowance and balance logic.
_spender is the key parameter written into allowance by approve.
_value is the amount parameter written into allowance by approve.
a is the target address supplied directly to the delegatecall unsafe operation.
b is the calldata supplied directly to the delegatecall unsafe operation.
_numList configures balances and the liquidity amounts inside list.
_tos is the recipient array iterated by list.
_amounts is the amount array iterated by list.
i is the local loop index of the balance-writing loop in list.
token0 is a local ordering variable used only by pairFor.
token1 is a local ordering variable used only by pairFor.
pair is the local return value computed by pairFor.
